 Follow Elizabeth Banks Revisits Effie Trinket at ‘The Hunger Games’ Premiere
 Catherine Kallon Tue, November 17, 2026 at 1:24 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Elizabeth Banks was back on the red carpet for the New York premiere of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , marking her first appearance at a franchise premiere since The Hunger Games: Mockingjay – Part 2 in 2015. And what a return.
 John Nacion/FilmMagic
 I couldn't resist looking back at her previous The Hunger Games press tours, which gave us some of her most memorable red carpet moments, including that gorgeous emerald-green Elie Saab dress , the stormy Elie Saab gown for the London premiere, and the gold Elie Saab Couture gown she wore to the Berlin premiere.
 Method dressing wasn't the phenomenon it is today, so I love that Elizabeth used this reunion as an opportunity to embrace Effie Trinket's eccentric style in a Christian Siriano Spring 2027 look.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The exaggerated shoulders of the cropped velvet jacket, the corset-style lacing and the voluminous floral skirt all feel like something Effie would happily wear.
 But it's the feather-like headpiece, complete with delicate strands sweeping across her face, that really sells the connection.
 Elizabeth gave us the glamour we remember from those earlier premieres, but this time with a look that could have come straight from the Capitol. I couldn't have asked for a better red carpet reunion.
 Christian Siriano Spring 2027
